print_tools.title: Print Tools plugin connection
print_tools.help: Create a personal 90-day credential, then enter this API URL and credential in the plugin's CRM connection settings. Credentials allow production-library changes, shared Gemini configuration and explicitly requested paid AI calls. They are stored hashed in CRM and can be revoked here. Never share them with clients.
print_tools.copy_once: Copy now — this credential is shown only once
